A flowchart showing Aristotle's classification of government. At the top, a question: "Who rules?". Three arrows point down to "One person", "A few people", and "Many people". Below "One person", a split shows "Good: Monarchy" and "Corrupt: Tyranny/Autocracy". Below "A few people", a split shows "Good: Aristocracy" and "Corrupt: Oligarchy". Below "Many people", a split shows "Good: Polity" and "Corrupt: Mob Rule". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background, distinct colours for Good (green) and Corrupt (red).

A split illustration contrasting Monarchy and Republicanism. On the left side (Monarchy): A golden crown resting on a velvet cushion. On the right side (Republicanism): A hand dropping a ballot paper into a transparent ballot box marked "VOTE".
